name: 22033 · Fairfax, VA
findings: ZIP 22033 (Fairfax) has 133 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22033 (Fairfax) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22033 (Fairfax) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22033 (Fairfax) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 social and fraternal organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
